summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package declares itself an ESLint TypeScript config but ships a `preinstall` lifecycle script (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases into a temp directory, marks it executable, and uses that freshly-downloaded alternate runtime to execute a local sibling file `math_init.js` — a 727KB bundle with hex-obfuscated identifiers (`_0x...`) and a shuffled string-array (rotation function `WV8StW` over a large mixed constants array). `setup.mjs` itself uses the same hex-identifier obfuscation and per-function string-map objects. Fetching a second language runtime at install time to execute an obfuscated bundled payload bypasses Node-focused scanners, and neither behavior is consistent with an ESLint config's declared purpose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
